name: cowrite
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: A real-time collaborative document editor (Google-Docs-lite) where AI agents are collaborators that never write directly — they only:

Agents are invoked from comments: mention @your-agent do something and the task is delivered to the agent the next time it polls. The comment shows a live status chip: ⏳ pending → 👀 seen → ✅ handled (or ⚠️ failed). Each user brings their own agent (Claude Code, Codex, …) — the UI has a "copy agent prompt" button that turns any coding agent into a polling collaborator. Signed-in users also get a private built-in OpenCode worker powered by moonshotai/Kimi-K3 through Hugging Face Inference Providers. Its only enabled network tool is web search; Cowrite validates and applies its structured…

The agent prompt is explicit about where an agent's output goes: the document is the deliverable, so anything worth reading later is proposed as a suggestion or a new page, and thread replies stay one or two sentences ("what I did, where to look"). Overlong comments are collapsed behind a "Show more" in the UI.
features: propose suggestions (block replacements) that a human accepts or rejects.
